plan.name: Keep the watcher's paths out of build records
plan.summary: A build's result.json, committed under refs/invariant/runs/ where anyone can fetch it, records synth.Result.Dir as an absolute path on the watcher's machine, which names its user. Before runBuild in internal/factory/factory.go saves the result, it records a copy whose Dir is relative to the factory's work directory, in slash form (such as issue-1/build-20260928-120000/result), or empty when the directory isn't under it; the live result the run uses is unchanged, and nothing reads Dir back from a saved record. The other records were checked: a draft's proposal holds only repository-relative project directories, and a plan build's record holds no paths. What's left for a follow-up is free-form error text, such as a run's saved Error, a draft's Problem and failure comments, which can quote a path under the work directory when an agent run fails.

tests.name: TestSavedBuildResultHoldsNoLocalPath
tests.says: A build's result saved under refs/invariant/runs/ for a run under a temporary work directory holds no absolute path and no part of the work directory's own path.
